bullets: Designed, developed, and maintained frontend-heavy enterprise web apps in React.js, with a focus on usability, responsiveness, and performance.
Built and consumed REST APIs and enterprise integrations using Node.js and Fiorano ESB/MSB.
Provided production support: frontend and backend debugging, log analysis, incident resolution, and performance tuning for live banking systems.
Wrote customer-facing API user guides and technical documentation that improved partner onboarding.
Built the Spending Tracker web application: user authentication, expense categorization, dashboards with real-time summaries, and persistent data storage.
Integrated frontend applications with RESTful APIs and databases; optimised UI performance and supported production deployments.
Worked directly with clients to refine requirements and ship polished, user-focused solutions.
